D: An ageing Michael Corleone tries to buy his way into legitimacy through the Vatican.
P: Hold the cannoli until the opera in the final act, and keep an eye on who made them.
S: chickpea fritters, salt and lemon, for the trip back to Sicily

Whisk 250g chickpea flour into 750ml salted water, cook stirring for 10 minutes until thick. Spread 1cm thick on an oiled tray, set, cut into squares and fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Lemon and salt.
sweet and sour Sicilian eggplant on toast

Fry cubed eggplant until golden, then soften celery and onion. Add tomato, capers, green olives, a spoon of sugar and red wine vinegar, simmer 10 minutes, fold in the eggplant. Cool, spoon onto toasted baguette with basil.
Rockmelon at room temperature, cut into long wedges and skinned. Drape with prosciutto di Parma, a crack of pepper and a drizzle of good olive oil.
M: hand-rolled in the kitchen while the family looks the other way

Bake 1kg floury potatoes, rice while hot, cool slightly, work in 1 yolk, salt and about 250g 00 flour until just smooth. Roll ropes, cut, cook until they float. Burnt butter with sage until nutty, parmesan.
eggplant, tomato and ricotta salata, straight from Sicily
Fry thick eggplant slices in olive oil until deep gold. Simmer garlic, San Marzano tomatoes and basil 20 minutes. Toss rigatoni with sauce and eggplant, grate ricotta salata heavily over the top.
W: ricotta and candied orange, eaten carefully in the opera box
Beat drained ricotta with icing sugar, cinnamon and chopped candied orange peel. Fill bought shells at the last minute, ends in chopped candied orange and pistachio.
K: a drink in the Palermo opera house before Cavalleria rusticana

Limoncello and prosecco over ice with a splash of soda, a strip of lemon peel and a sprig of fresh mint. Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice. Pour 40ml limoncello into each, then top each with 90ml chilled prosecco and 30ml soda water. Stir once gently so you keep the bubbles. Peel 4 wide strips of zest from 1 lemon, twist each over a glass to release the oil and drop it in. Finish with a small sprig of mint.

dishes.make_ahead: Set up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; fry just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the chickpea flour into the cold water with the salt until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until very thick.
Stir in the parsley and spread 1cm thick on an oiled tray. Leave to set for 1 hour.
Cut into squares and fry in 180C oil in batches until puffed and golden.
Drain, salt and serve with lemon wedges.
Leave the rockmelon at room temperature for an hour.
Halve, deseed, cut into 12 long wedges and cut off the skin.
Drape each wedge with prosciutto, add pepper and a drizzle of olive oil just before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days ahead; fry eggplant on the day

steps.text: Cut the eggplants into thick half moons and fry in batches in most of the olive oil until deep gold. Drain.
Fry the garlic in 2 tbsp of oil, add the tomatoes and basil, simmer and season.
Cook the rigatoni until al dente.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, eggplant and a splash of pasta water. Grate ricotta salata heavily over the top.

dishes.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead; fill shells just before serving

ingredients.item: icing sugar, plus extra for dusting

steps.text: Drain the ricotta in a sieve for 2 hours.
Beat with icing sugar, cinnamon and candied peel.
Pipe into the shells just before serving.
Dip each end in pistachios and dust with icing sugar.
Fill four large wine glasses with ice.
Pour limoncello into each, top with prosecco and soda and stir once gently.
Peel a wide strip of lemon zest per glass, twist over the drink and drop in. Finish with mint.
Boil the fennel in salted water until tender, lift out and chop, keeping the water for the pasta.
Soften the onion in olive oil, melt in the anchovies, then add raisins, pine nuts, saffron and chopped fennel.
Add the sardines and cook gently for a few minutes until they flake.
Cook the pasta in the fennel water until al dente, toss with the sauce and top with toasted crumbs.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Beat the ricotta with the icing sugar until smooth.
Line four small moulds with sponge, brush with Marsala or juice and fill with ricotta.
Chill until firm, at least 2 hours.
Roll out the marzipan, cover each cake and crown with candied fruit.
Chill the Marsala and pour a small glass for each guest.
Brew four short, strong black coffees.
Serve in small cups.

edition.cue: Hold the cannoli until the opera in the final act, and keep an eye on who made them.

s.note: Golden chickpea fritters fried crisp, finished with lemon and salt.
s.how: Whisk 250g chickpea flour into 750ml cold water with 1 tsp salt until smooth. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 10 minutes until very thick. Add 2 tbsp chopped parsley, spread 1cm thick on an oiled tray and leave to set for 1 hour. Cut into squares and fry in 180C oil until puffed and golden. Drain, salt, and serve with lemon wedges.

s.note: Ripe rockmelon wedges draped with prosciutto, pepper and olive oil.
s.how: Leave 1 rockmelon at room temperature for an hour. Halve, scoop out the seeds, cut into 12 long wedges and cut off the skin. Drape each wedge with a slice of prosciutto (about 150g in total), add a crack of black pepper and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil just before serving.

m.note: Rigatoni with fried eggplant, tomato and basil, under grated ricotta salata.
m.how: Cut 2 eggplants into thick half moons and fry in batches in 120ml olive oil until deep gold, drain. Fry 3 sliced garlic cloves in 2 tbsp of the oil, add 800g San Marzano tomatoes and a handful of basil, simmer 20 minutes and season. Cook 500g rigatoni until al dente, toss with the sauce, eggplant and a splash of pasta water. Grate 100g ricotta salata heavily over the top.

w.note: Crisp shells filled with sweet ricotta, candied orange and pistachio.
w.how: Drain 500g fresh ricotta in a sieve for 2 hours. Beat with 80g icing sugar, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon and 40g finely chopped candied orange peel. Spoon into a piping bag and fill 8 cannoli shells just before serving. Dip each end in 30g chopped pistachios and dust with a little more icing sugar.

d.note: Limoncello and prosecco over ice with a splash of soda, a strip of lemon peel and a sprig of fresh mint.
d.how: Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice. Pour 40ml limoncello into each, then top each with 90ml chilled prosecco and 30ml soda water. Stir once gently so you keep the bubbles. Peel 4 wide strips of zest from 1 lemon, twist each over a glass to release the oil and drop it in. Finish with a small sprig of mint.
